Visited the Amintiri cafe at HSR layout after wanting to go there for a few months and it did not disappoint. We ordered the eggs benedict, their avo croissant sandwich, egg and chicken salami croissant sandwich, cold coffee, their signature hot chocolate, their strawberry and Nutella French toast and their V60 pour over. We enjoyed them all. We  went ahead and reordered their chicken and egg croissant sandwich as we loved it that much. Would recommend this place for anyone looking to go out in groups for breakfast/brunch for sure. The place is clean, well lit and spaced out. Great for outing with family and kids.
